notes: Diffusion is net particle movement down a concentration gradient. A membrane is not required, although diffusion can also occur across membranes. Osmosis specifically concerns net water movement across a selectively permeable membrane, from higher water potential (more dilute solution) to lower water potential (more concentrated solution). Both are passive processes; neither requires the cell to supply metabolic energy.
